Thus, the heat is generated and the temperature of LED increases which affects LED performance and life adversely. In this paper, the momentum and energy equations are solved using Ansys FLUENT. The procedure for an axisymmetric analysis has been developed. Two cases - the air inside the cavity and an extended air envelop below the LED light in addition to the air in the cavity have been compared. The interaction between air in the cavity and in the room shows significant advantage and maximum temperature reduces to 403 K as compared to the isolated air in the cavity at 438 K. The study shows that the natural convection currents can influence the heavier air away from the heating zone also resulting in increased heat transfer.

articleTitle: Load Management and Techno Economic Analysis of Grid-Connected Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid system to analyze the techno-economic analysis of grid connected power system. Case study has been done on a school in the northern city of India, Uttar Pradesh. The hybrid system comprises of diesel generator and solar photovoltaic as an effective option to manage the typical load or demand of the school thereby bringing down the further electrification cost. The hybrid model has been proposed for different load variations that would effectively reduce the operation and maintenance cost. A proper survey and study has been conducted for finding the load requirements of the school to compute accurate results. The Hybrid Optimization of Multiple Energy Resources (HOMER) software is used to assess the economics of the hybrid system to provide clean and renewable energy. Further, comparative studies for different scenarios have been done for the proposed model so as to provide viable option to move forward renewable sources in the given case.

articleTitle: Minimum Component Grounded Inductor Simulator employing CDDITA
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: In this paper a new electronically tunable inductance simulation circuit using a new generation active element, namely Current Differencing Differential Input Transconductance Amplifier (CDDITA) has been reported. The developed configuration is a minimum component realization with only two CDDITAs and a single grounded capacitance. This circuit has many other beneficial features like: 1)purely resistorless configuration, 2)use of only single grounded capacitance, 3)availability of electronic tuning of realized inductance through bias currents, 4)satisfactory non ideal performance and 5)small values of passive/active sensitivity indexes. The study of developed configuration under the influence of CDDITA terminal parasitic has been also carried out. The working of all the developed circuits has been verified by running simulation in PSPICE environment with CMOS based CDDITA.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sliding Mode Controller using Finite-Time Functional Observer for Continuous-time LTI Systems with Unknown Inputs
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the problem of adaptive sliding mode controller (ASMC) using finite-time functional observer (FFO) for linear systems with unknown inputs. Sliding mode controller (SMC) is designed by the adaptive tuning method. Further, an FFO based on the asymptotic functional observer (AFO) and the full-order observer is designed. Then, compares the performance of an FFO and the AFO. Moreover, SMC is calculated using FFO technique. A numerical example and its simulation results show the simplicity and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Cascaded Multi-level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: A modern breed of multilevel inverters has come into view as the panacea for working with high voltage levels. Multilevel inverters have conferred more recognition in industrial application, such as electric drives, static VAR compensation and renewable systems etc. Basically, multilevel inverters were avowed to have output voltages sequence with more than two-levels. Consequently, the inverter output voltages have decreased harmonic fluctuations and high class of waveforms. These attributes make multilevel inverter to reach for high-power and high-voltage applications. Different kinds of multilevel inverter topologies have been suggested to reduce the THD (Total Harmonics Distortation). Furthermore, comparative analysis has been done to control the output voltage by varying the amplitudes of two different modulating signals. The approach of designing i.e. important features for selecting the controller, bipolar IGBT driver circuit design with an optical isolation, low voltage isolated power supplies for bipolar driver cards and high voltage isolated power supplies for each H-bridge, importance of delay circuit in inverters and design procedure for selecting minimum LC filter size to eliminate harmonics in load has been presented in the paper. The performance analysis and results are verified with MATLAB Simulink and confirmed by experimental results.

articleTitle: Voltage Stability and Power Loss Enhancement of Distribution System using Dragonfly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Optimal allocation of Distributed Generation in Distribution System is a challenging issue in present era. In this paper Distributed Generation placement in Distribution System for improving voltage profile of the buses and power loss minimization is presented. An integrated Voltage Stability Index and Dragonfly Algorithm based optimal allocation is carried out in this paper. Various case studies are simulated on standard IEEE 83 bus practical test system using the intimated approach. Further the results obtained are competitive and shows the efficiency of the presented method.

articleTitle: Survey of Stochastic Computing for Hardware implementation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Stochastic Computing (SC) is another substitute way to deal with digital information. With ongoing advances in Internet of Thigs (IOT) and wearable gadgets it is interesting to implement Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Image Processing applications on reconfigurable platform. However, several elements and very complicated connections are usually required, which leads to more hardware and power consumption. Stochastic Computing (SC) meet stringent requirement in embedded and mobile IOT devices. SC is an alternate approach to deterministic computing that treats binary data as probabilities. SC employs very low-complexity arithmetic units. SC is popular in immensely parallel systems and is exceptionally tolerant to soft errors. SC based hardware execution achieves low hardware foot print, low power and energy competent circuits while preserving high accuracy. This paper surveys SC's the low cost, low complexity, error tolerant, alternative to binary computing.

articleTitle: Application of cascaded H-bridge multi level inverter for PV based induction motor
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: The Photovoltaic power generation has been found to be most promising in distributed generation among the various non-conventional energy sources. Photovoltaic cell produces de power which is suitable for dc loads, to use this power for ac loads an inverter becomes necessity for photovoltaic cells. In case of conventional inverter a filter becomes necessary component; consequently increases the installation cost and adds complexity to the system. A cascaded H-bridge multi level inverter (MLI) has been found as a better alternative. This paper presents a photovoltaic system to drive three-phase induction motor using cascaded H-bridge MLI. For balancing the dc-bus (link) capacitor voltage individual maximum power point tracker (MPPT) control method has been adopted. The whole system is validated by analyzing the performance of three-phase induction motor.

articleTitle: A study of optimization algorithms applied to Integrated Renewable Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: In today's world the per capita energy consumption is the important indicator of the development status of any country. The reliability of electricity power is becoming equally important as the quality of power. The significance of integrating different available energy sources for making an Integrating Renewable Energy System (IRES) is gaining more attractions in making a fully reliable energy system. These renewable based Integrating systems are capable enough to overcome the limitations of the individual generating system especially in reducing carbon dioxide emission and increasing reliability. Integration of renewable energy systems eliminates the concerns related with stochastic nature of solar photovoltaic (SPV) and wind energy systems (WES). An integrated energy system with the facility of energy storage is substantially improves the flexibility and efficiency of power supply. For proper sizing of IRES a numbers of parameters are need to be optimized with various constraints associated with individual energy source component. The designing of efficient IRES is totally based on realization of techno-economic and social objectives. In this research paper an overview of various technics used for optimal sizing of IRES have been presented.

articleTitle: Application of Loss Sensitivity Factor and Grass hopper Optimization Algorithm for Solving Distributed Generator and Capacitor allocation Problem in Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Reduction of power loss is a prominent issue for Distribution System in present era. Better allocation of DGs and shunt capacitor in DS plays a predominant role to achieve prescribed results. Further, most of the researchers considered these sources individually. In this paper a combined methodology of loss sensitivity factor and grasshopper optimization is proposed to solve this problem. Identification of possible locations is done by LSF method. Further, ratings are determined using GOA. At last, the potency of the developed method is verified on IEEE 83 bus system. To study the efficacy of the method several cases are used. The perceived results show its dominance of the developed methodology.

articleTitle: Internet Of Things (IOT) in Distribution grid using DSTATCOM
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: In view of the problem of low power factor in distribution lines the smart technology like Internet Of Things (IOT) is used for continuous monitoring of the system. Timely sending notification through wireless communication, alerts the grid users about power factor fluctuations. In this paper DSTATCOM is interfaced with IOT technology to improve power factor and real time monitoring of the distribution line. The software design for low power factor discrimination and communication module uses JAVA programming and integrated in MATLAB through calling procedure. The performance of the DSTATCOM with IOT is demonstrated using simulation results in MATLAB/SIMULINK software. The IOT module collects the data of low power factor and sends mail notification to the registered Gmail account.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Parameter Estimation Techniques for Modelling a Twin Rotor MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the parameter estimation techniques for the modelling of Twin Rotor Multi Input Multi Output System and make a comparative study for the applied estimation techniques based on the generated model's fit to the actual system. Time delay problem in twin rotor systems specifically during the hovering of the system is the major issue that needs to be addressed strongly for finding a solution. In order to address the time delay issues, the system should be modelled appropriately to pave way for designing accurate control methodologies. Parameter estimation techniques like Autoregressive with Exogenous Input (ARX) and Autoregressive Moving Average with Exogenous input (ARMAX) methods are used to model the system. Extended Least Square algorithm is used to tune the obtained model. The model obtained by using ARX method was found to be more suitable for the system as they were more resistant to noise interference. A complete analysis of different order of systems of ARX and ARMAX models of one Degree Of Freedom(DOF) is performed.

articleTitle: A New Visual Cryptography Scheme with Perfect Contrast using Galois Fields
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This article proposes a novel <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> out of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n$</tex> visual cryptography procedure using secret sharing techniques for Galois Fields. articleTitle: Secure Data Carrying Methodology Through Digital Protection Wall Using Higher LSB Technique over Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: The secrecy and security of information has always been important to the people whenever it come to confidential data. Today there is advancement in internet technology and hence there has been increase in use of text and multimedia data transfer over internet. Thus this motivates us to add another layer of security to secrete data,which hides the confidential information within carrier. The carrier we used is the transfer of images that can hide secret information within the region of image. The paper proposes half toning visual cryptography technique with digital protection wall. Technique improves the imperceptibility as well as capacity of carrier by considering higher LSB layer for hiding secret information and replacing RGB component bit with secret information. Thus transfer of carrier through wireless media and recovering the secret data at receiving side. The data is extracted simply by using reverse algorithm. And the capacity, imperceptibility is compared by using various factors like cross correlation, MS error, peak to signal noise ratio. The executed protection wall is flexible so that carrier can hide the data within the protected area and shall protect from unauthorized user which will be known to receiver only.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modelling of Vertically Cascaded Triple Micro Optical Ring Resonator (VCTMORR) with 1X2 I/O Ports
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Z-domain modelling approach of vertically cascaded triple micro optical ring resonator (VCTMORR) with 1X2 I/O waveguides is proposed in this article. This ring resonator structure is modelled by employing delay line approach and Mason's rule. Performance characteristics of proposed structure are evaluated in MATLAB platform with graphical representation of free spectral range (FSR), group delay (GD), dispersion (DP) and finesse. Expanded FSR with zero crosstalk is the main objective of this work which is achieved in this architecture. Hence this model can be systematically manipulated in optical communication system with a huge number of communication channel. Couplers are designed in finite difference time domain (FDTD) technique. A different design approach of directional optical couplers is formulated here.

articleTitle: Stability Improvement of SMIB System using TLBO Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: In this paper, Phillips Heffron model of single machine infinite bus system (SMIB) is shown with the static series synchronous compensator (SSSC) based damping controller to damp out low frequency oscillation. The main aim is to get cost-effective damping of low-frequency oscillations. The SSSC based controller design is based on GTO for controlling various parameters involved. To further improve the responsiveness of the designed controller, its parameters were tuned and optimized using Teacher Learner Based Optimization (TLBO) algorithm. The simulation was carried out in MATLAB and tested for change in mechanical torque input with different parameters setting. The results obtained were compared with the system without any controller and with Gravitational Search Algorithm (GSA) based system. Hence, verified its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Analysis of Different Controllers on SMPS Based Charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Within any electrical-electronic system, power supply assumes a unique role by, providing consistent and repeatable power to its circuit. In addition, it serves as a medium (defender) between the mains and the circuit. Switched Mode Power Supply (SMPS) is the most prevailing architecture for DC power supply in modern systems, primarily for its capability to handle variable loads. Apart from efficiency the size and weight of the power supplies is becoming a great area of concern for the Power Supply Designers. With constant research and advancement in the field of artificial intelligence, the control operation can be enhanced with the use of artificial intelligence control techniques. The SMPS which can be widely classified into isolated and non-isolated topologies. The PWM control of the power MOSFET in SMPS is enhanced with use of AI. In this thesis the different AI control techniques such as fuzzy control, artificial neural network control and particle swarming optimization are implemented and the results are compared.

articleTitle: Novel Technique For Detection Of Power Quality Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This paper presents the detection of power quality (PQ) events using mathematical morphology and classification of the events using statistical parameter such as standard deviation. The mathematical morphology is used to detect the events. By using mathematical morphology the feature is extracted that is morphological gradient. The morphological gradient can be determined from the erosion and dilation of the given test signal. At start of the event the morphological gradient gives the pulse as well at the end of the event pulse is obtained. So the threshold value is set based on to the normal voltage signal without disturbance. If the morphological gradient exceeds the threshold value the flag goes high and it indicates the initiation of events similarly at end of the events the flag goes high. The statistical parameter such as standard deviation (STD) is used for the classification of the events such as voltage sag, voltage swell and interruption. The STD is determined for half cycle from the initiation of the events again the threshold value is set for the classification. The five samples of the voltage sag, swell and interruption events are recorded using the trailer made experimentation in the laboratory. The methodology is tested over it. The method is very easy as well as simple to implement and faster. It works with the experimental data consisting a lot of noise; this is the strength of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimal Parameter Setting for Directional Relay in Multi Machine System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Enhancement of directional over-present day transfer (DOCR) settings is a basic issue in electrical designing. The advancement model of the issue ends up being non-direct and rather controlled wherein settings especially time dial putting (TDS) and fitting setting (PS) of each hand-off are mulled over as choice factors; the total of the working occasions of all the essential transfers., which are anticipated to work that enables you to clear the issues in their relating zones., is considered as a goal include. In the predominant analyze., demonstrate thought about especially IEEE eight-transport form. To comprehend the problem., we have connected PSO based wellbeing upgrade. The outcomes are as contrasted and the traditional arrangement of guidelines to be had inside the writing; the numerical outcomes demonstrate that the changed calculations outflank or perform at standard with different calculations. In light of the coordination results acquired on this investigations., the proposed molecule swarm enhancement set of principles can be utilized to compute the settings of the directional overcurrent transfers in a distribution community with allotted generation. The proposed set of rules has shown to have the potential to keep selectivity among the relays being coordinated and limit the running times of the primary relays for close-in 3-section faults.

articleTitle: Multi-Criteria Pareto-Based Control Loop Performance Assessment
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: A multi-criteria Pareto-based assessment method is proposed, which enables to consider different aspects related to control loop performance, possibly in contradiction. For example, it is well-known that the Minimum Variance Controller (MVC) is very aggressive from the manipulated variable u(k) point of view. Therefore, it is not to be considered as desirable for a commisioned system working in real conditions. We propose an approach to cope with this issue, focusing on the trade-off between process variable y(k) and u(k) energy. More precisely, we compare the values of three performance indicators for three different pure proportional controllers. Our example illustrates that the proposed indicators are more sensitive to small changes in loop parameters, which could be useful for maintenance purposes, e.g. to detect performance degradation.

articleTitle: Simulation of Fuzzy Logic Controller for Boost Converter in Renewable Energy and HVDC Application
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This paper exhibits the arranging and recreation of a DC-DC boost convertor that utilizations PV Cell as input source. These days, sun based could be a sort of sustainable power source that is economical and clean contrasted with various vitality. DC-DC boost convertor is wont to extend the produced voltage to level legitimate for HVDC transmission. During this paper, a control frameworks DC-DC step up or boost convertor circuit was organized and reenactment simulating MATLAB SIMULINK primarily founded after a topological circuit. Inside the recreation, the converter was tried with various input voltage. To help the produced voltage ripple redaction, FLC is planned and executed at the converter to line the obligation duty of the switch gadget for the boost convertor. The outcome has demonstrated higher execution for boost convertor with fuzzy logic controller.

articleTitle: Interval Derivatives Based Approach for Multiple DGs allocation Considering Variation in Input Parameters
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: The paper discloses a new and effective methodology in order to solve the problem of distributed generation (DG) unit (s)' allocations using a new the interval arithmetic programming (IvP) for radial configuration of distribution network (DN) taking variations of input parameters. In real, the input quantities (feeder resistance and reactance, and loads at various buses) are of varying nature in real and assume them constant when perform the load flow study. Interval arithmetic (IA) affords a strict bound solution of such problems and efficiently incorporate with such uncertainties. This paper considers the variations in values of load parameters. The developed load flow algorithm also considers the effect of shunt admittance, which is usually neglected. An efficient IA based load flow is developed which take cares of the uncertainties of input load parameters, and compared it with load flow based on repeated simulations. For sizing and siting of DG few analytical expressions are developed based on the minimization of losses related to the active and reactive branch current in complex intervals. A 69-bus networks with radial configurations is used to demonstrate and validate the efficiency of the proposed method with IA based and repeated simulation based load flow (RPLF).

articleTitle: Islanding Detection and Prevention by Using FACTS Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: The inauguration in Distributed Generation Technologies(DG) have started to imposing business models transmission framework's engineering right away when saying its freedom and deregulating of the vitality market to the overall population. Such development has impelled awful rivalries among power age firms to start unrivaled advancements in gathering buyers' wants, managing power quality anyway practical. With combination of distributed generation technology, grid operations dynamically benefit from said recommended services that avoid power outages; assurance of the quality of the energy, adaptation of unstable demand curves, use of compensation faults and other auxiliary services. Subsequently, the presence of DG revolution in management of the power grid for the development of off-grid and self-sufficient criteria, which usually use adaptation solutions for the grid / islanding topology. However, when using island mode proposition, the potential impact of an unplanned paradox due to an ineffective detection control scheme is valid. Drawn out coincidental islanding-mode activity will distress unfortunate obliteration of utility's assets and considered monetarily unbeneficial which results in compromise with safety and serviceability. Therefore, this analysis reflects the contrasting dynamics of adopting passive or active islanding detection methods supported by selected passive algorithms; under voltage over voltage and under/over frequency detection (passive). With this we are apply a LC filter FACTS device VSC based controlling a islanding phenomenon. Investigating of Time analysis and prevention technique in islanding mode.

articleTitle: Energy Conservation through Lighting Audit- A Case Study of Hostel Building
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: The gap between supply and demand of energy is continuously increasing. Increase in energy prices, acute energy shortages and supply gap are the issues of concern and hence efficiency of the supply system and energy conservation measures have gained importance in the recent years. In view of this to understand and analyze the energy utilization for improving efficiency with cost benefit analysis and to reduce the energy consumption, Energy Audit is being considered for the present work. Lighting is an area which provides a major scope to achieve energy efficiency and conservation by incorporation of modern energy efficiency lamps. In this present work lighting Audit of “Malaprabha Basaveshwar Engineering College Ladies Hostel” Bagalkot, Karnataka is considered, mentioning that annual contribution of only lighting loads towards energy consumption is 24.4% of total load. Audit is conducted for lighting loads by walk through survey of all the four buildings of the hostel and power consumption pattern is determined. It is observed that replacing old luminaries, with energy efficient luminaries 50% of total cost of energy can be saved per year with the payback period of 8 to 10 years. Further suggesting that selected rooms of the hostel building receiving less natural light should be taken for renovation considering students comfort. Finally, Energy conservation Measures (ECM's) are recommended to reduce the energy consumption by light loads. The outcome of the present work will help in reducing the energy costs of hostel and further improvements in the energy conservation can be done by performing Energy Audit of the hostel considering different types of load and also present study model can be recommended to similar hostel buildings that will help in the energy conservation across the country.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Nearest Level Modulation Scheme for a Cascaded/Series Connected Switched Sources (SCSS) based MLI
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This paper proposes a nearest level modulation (NLM) scheme for a Cascaded/Series Connected Switched Sources (SCSS) based MLI topology. The proposed modulation scheme is found to facilitate a reduction in the total harmonic distortion (THD) at the ac output of the inverter. The modulation scheme employs low switching frequency to operate the MLI. Simulation has been implemented using the MATLAB/Simulink 2015a software package. The simulation results indicate a major reduction in the voltage THD and current THD. Improvement in the different output parameters of the inverter like RMS voltage and output power is also seen.

Author Keywords: Cascaded/Series Connected Switched Sources (SCSS) based MLI

articleTitle: Integrated Bluetooth UWB Antenna with Reconfigurable Characteristics including rejection of Dual Interfering Bands using Parasitic Elements Backed Plane for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: In the presented research article, a modified hexagon patch antenna with modified rectangular ground plane is used to obtain Ultrawideband (UWB) bandwidth (3.16GHz-10.62GHz). To mitigate the interference caused by WLAN Band (5.150GHz-5.825GHz) and Downlink X-Band Satellite System (7.25GHz-7.75GHz), pair of C-shaped parasitic elements are placed backed plane behind radiating patch. Antenna is characterized in terms of near field, far field and spatial regions providing good matching of impedance in entire operating band. Proposed antenna also offers stable gain except notched bands, high radiation efficiency and required 2-D radiation patterns in E- and H-plane. Antenna is compact in size and makes it suitable candidate for different wireless applications.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network based controller design for SMPS
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to design a controller for a half-bridge converter based Switched Mode Power Supply of 150W rating. A half-bridge converter is designed for obtaining a stiffly regulated DC output voltage of 5V irrespective of load and supply voltage variations, with an artificial neural network (ANN) based controller. The duty ratio of the controller is determined by this ANN depending on the input voltage and the output load conditions. Data collection for training the ANN was done using a PID controller-based approach in which the transfer function for the SMPS was derived by performing the large signal and small signal analyses and appropriate parameter values for the PID controller were calculated. For different load and input supply voltage conditions, the output voltage was regulated by making use of the PID controller and appropriate duty ratios were arrived at. These 150 data points were used for the training the proposed ANN with four hidden layers. The trained neural network was further utilized in arriving at the duty ratio value directly by sensing the input voltage and load current and it is found to yield stiffly regulated voltage irrespective of supply voltage and load variations where the error is within 8 %.

articleTitle: A multimodal approach for localization of Ackerman steering micro ground vehicles in bad GPS reception environments
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: A closed-loop control system requires a state estimator for feedback. In the domain of mobile robots, this is called localization. The problem of localization for micro ground vehicles in outdoor environments with no modifications to the environment is a challenging one as the tolerances for micro ground vehicles are lower. The error in the data from the GPS is higher for ground vehicles than it is for aerial vehicles in urban environments. Different approaches such as the use of optical flow and non-holonomic constraints have been explored in the past on an individual basis but have their disadvantages. In this work, these methods, along with a mathematical model of the physical system were studied individually and then combined together to eliminate their individual pitfalls. This significantly increased the reliability of the system across different scenarios.

articleTitle: PID and MRAC control of a Quadrotor
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: A Quadrotor is an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) which has four rotors. It is a non-linear multivariable system which is highly underactuated. Voltage-based approach using Newton-Euler technique is used to derive the quadrotor's equations-of-motion. These equations are then used to develop a Simulink model and the output responses for roll, pitch and yaw angles are achieved. First, a PID controller is used and then, Model Reference Adaptive Control (MRAC) technique is used. The results obtained for both the control techniques are compared with respect to their response to a step input and the settling time of the output response.

articleTitle: Integral Order PID Controller for Linear Time Invariant of Nonlinear Model of Dynamic Biological Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: The paper explains the control of disorder in the biological system. A novel controller based on the Integral Order PID (IOPID) control method is proposed, which can control the dynamics of the Linear Time-Invariant based (LTI) biological system such as Genetic Regulatory Network (GRN) of DNA, Protein formation and Pancreas to stabilize at any point or to follow any approach in a smooth function of time. Moreover, the integral control is proposed to attain the better stability condition of the fault dynamics. Hence the necessary stability condition is derived based on stability theory. The simulation model is developed in MATLAB/Simulink environment. Statistical model outcomes are obtained to demonstrate the successful validation of the proposed controller design. Consequently, the simulation results of the proposed controller compared with other controller and achieved the goal successfully.

articleTitle: Signature Analysis of Electrical Faults in Standalone PV Systems with Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Stand-alone PV systems are increasingly becoming popular as a viable alternative to utility power supply, especially in remote corners, where accessibility is a problem to deploy conventional distribution systems. It is also becoming a choice of conscious consumers who wish to contribute to environment protection through use of green energy. In this context, it is vital to have a fault diagnosis system in place to identify various faults in the PV system. This paper presents a signature analysis of various electrical faults in a stand-alone PV system, with battery storage. The focus of the work is to minimize the sensors to be deployed for detection and classification of the faults.

articleTitle: Tri-Band Monopole Antenna for UMTS (1920–2170 MHz), WiMAX (3.4-3.6GHz) and WLAN (5.15-5.35GHz) Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: In this research article, a tapered microstrip feed rectangular patch multiband antenna is presented. Antenna also consists of rectangular ground plane. Proposed antenna is simulated on FR4 substrate with electrical properties includes permittivity 4.4 and loss tangent 0.002. Patch consists of two stubs which are responsible for UMTS and WiMAX resonating frequencies. A etched slot on the patch results in WLAN band leading to tri-band operation of antenna. Simulated antenna is characterized in terms of near and far filed region results. Antenna offers good radiation pattern in principal planes with maximum gain of 4.63dBi and efficiency of 89% in operating bands.

articleTitle: Discrete-time Quasi-Sliding Mode Control of Singularly Perturbed Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This paper presents a discrete-time quasi-sliding mode control design of singularly perturbed systems. At the first step, slow and fast sliding mode controllers are designed for the subsystems, individually. Then we achieve the composite sliding mode control input. Control input is free from the perturbed parameters. Consequently, Stability analysis of slow, fast and composite systems are investigated using the Lyapunov method. The performance and validity of the given control scheme are developed by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Real time implementation of motion transfer mechanism for master slave robotic configuration
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This paper presented the design and development of motion transfer technique from master handle to slave side on one degree of freedom (DoF) master slave robotic configuration. Single DoF master handle has been designed and fabricated using 3D printer. The position feedback mechanism algorithms has been written in LabVIEW to transfer the motion from master handle to slave motor. The position of master handle has been measured in real time through an encoder embedded in the master side motor and it has been transferred to the slave side in order to mimic position of master handle. The developed system is capable of measuring the position of the master handle with resolution of 0.0879 degree and the same has been achieve by transferring the motion to slave side. The accuracy has been calculated on the basis of the position produced by master handle and the position tracked by the slave side and the designed system is able to track the motion with the steady state error ranges between - 0,06 to 0.06 degree. The developed system is useful in any master-slave robotic configuration.

articleTitle: CNT based Wearable ECG Sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Wearable sensors deliver real-time and vital information of the individual's health conditions. The concept of smart textiles has lately progressed due to significant demand for wearable electronics and technology in addition to flexible and light-weight sensors for bio-potential monitoring. Also, it helps in acquiring bio-signals in a non-invasive manner. For assessing the heart health hazards now-a-days, the medical devices are nowadays incorporating nanomaterials. Nanomaterials, especially CNTs (Carbon Nanotubes), are used in the medical domain. Due to their exceptional conductivity and mechanical strength, CNTs are used for sensing applications in the medical domain. As CNTs are entangled, they form networks which help in the conduction procedure. Therefore, these are exquisite for acquiring weak bio-signals such as ECG. As the death rates due to various CVDs (Cardiovascular Diseases) have taken a toll, it becomes imperative to continuously monitor the cardiac activities to minimize deaths due to sudden heart attacks, etc. To fulfill this requirement, the ECG sensors should be light-weight and comfortable to the wearer. Hence, CNTs can be utilized for this purpose. Consequently, the acquired ECG signals can be transmitted to the medical fraternity, hence saving lives of various people. Hence, in this paper, we discuss various techniques for fabricating CNT based wearable ECG sensors.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of 1-Phase 5-Level T-style Multilevel Inverter using Advanced PWM Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: The basic idea of a multi-level inverter for higher power is to use a series of semiconductor(power) switches with multiple reduced voltage dc sources in order to convert the energy by synchronizing a waveform of the staircase voltage. Multilevel inverter is capable of increasing output voltage and efficiency with small switching losses and total harmonic distortion as the level improves the harmonic itself. This paper proposes a 1-phase 5-level T-style inverter with various SPWM strategies having less number of devices which possess high and low power region as compared to conventional inverter. Generally, it is used for low power appliances having maximum efficiency. A 1-phase 5-level T-style inverter has been introduced and multi-carrier PWM technology is used to produce 5-level stage output voltage for multilevel inverter strategies. Furthermore, simulation outcomes of a 5-level multi-level inverter topology are performed using MATLAB. / SIMULINK. R2014a with different SPWM approaches such as PD, POD, APOD, ISWCPWM, HRPWM modulation methods.

articleTitle: Reduction of Effective Disturbance in Six Phase Induction Machine Employing Field Oriented Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Generally in these days multiphase induction machines are used in industries to meet the demand of high output power. When these induction machines are subjected to sudden change in the load torque there will be some effect on speed of the machine and reduces the performance. To obtain this, effective disturbance Rotor field oriented control strategy is employed along with input of feed forward TL as an identical to q-axis iqL current and controllers like PI, ANFIS and FLC. The performance of proposed method is tested by employing MATLAB/Simulink and the Simulation results shown that FLC, ANFIS are given better performance compared with PI control.

articleTitle: Steady State and Dynamic Response of A Large and A Small Induction Machine via Modelling and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Prior knowledge of the expected steady state as well as the dynamic response of a machine is useful for hardware operation. In this work, the study of the electromechanical behaviour of an induction machine is carried out through MATLAB, wherein the dynamics between a high rating induction machine and a low rating induction machine is presented. A generic model in combination with the dynamic model is represented for the analytical research purposes. Critical parameters for the transient-stability performances of the two types of induction machines are perused with the aid of mathematical equations.

articleTitle: Towards A Deep FLANN For Prediction Of Stock Market Returns
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Stock prediction of an individual company is an important and difficult problem for wealth management. Many techniques have been developed for analysis of stock market, however, it remains a challenging problem. One approach is to use deep learning for stock price prediction and some success has been reported in literature with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). This paper proposes deep functional link neural network for stock predictions as functional link artificial neural networks (FLANN) are single-layer neural networks which can solve complex problems by generating nonlinear decision boundaries. It is conjectured that deep FLANN would benefit from the ability of deep learning to handle complex problems generated from multiple hidden layers and interconnection of neurons as well as from the inherent capability of single layer FLANN to handle difficult problems. Initial investigations show that average performance of Deep FLANN is better than the single-layer FLANN as well as CNN for prediction of stock prices of a set of companies listed on Korean Stock market.

Author Keywords: Deep Functional link artificial neural network

articleTitle: DSP Based Photovoltaic Hardware Development for Controlling Voltage and Current
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Based on principle of photoelectric effects the photovoltaic (PV) module generates DC power. But this power and its maximum value, voltage and current are varying in the line with the changing solar irradiance and its maximum power has to be tracked through some suitable techniques. In the present work, DSP based hardware design of 100W Alpex PV module with a Buck-Boost Converter for controlling voltage and current has been made. The fuzzy logic Controller(FLC) based algorithm is used here and the same has been implemented on DSP kit Model C2000 series of TMD_SPREX-28335 bench.

articleTitle: Design and Simulate the Modified Circuits of Switched Capacitor Filter using mentor graphics tool
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Designed updated circuits of switched capacitor filters. Parasitic capacitance free transfer function based SC integrators are between different ground & nodes. SC high Pass, SC low pass and SC all pass switched capacitor filter circuits: equations are designed. The application of these type of filters to improved gain, 3decibel frequency, ts, Input Common Mode Range, Common Mode Rejection Ratio range, UGF, phase margin. Discrete prototypes of switched capacitor filters are used to verify the theory.

articleTitle: Effect of Frequency Variation on Fault Location in Transmission Line Using Synchrophasor Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Fault location and isolation are important in case of any transmission line to make a reduction in the outage time and fast restoration of the transmission system. Various methods of fault location using voltage samples and current samples have been used in practice but with the development of Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) many new method have been designed. The two terminal method of fault location is employed to calculate the fault location as the present communication technology used to access of data from two terminal. In the above method fault impedance does not affects the location. The main aim of this project paper is to calculate the exact fault location and compare the result of calculated fault location and its error with and without frequency variations. For the study, Electromagnetic Transient Program (EMTP) Reference Models for Transmission Line Relay Testing Final-9/9/2005 is considered. The deception of the selected method is analyzed and evaluated by simulating the network in PSCAD under both steady state and transient conditions after that result are transferred into MATLAB Simulink for the further processing and result are obtained.

articleTitle: On the Modeling of Multistable Memory States Using Memristor
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Memristor is a fundamental circuit element which has promising application in neuromorphic computing. In this paper, linear Strukov model is used for showing how the internal state varies in a memristor when driven by a sinusoidal excitation source. Simulation results show, memristor achieves higher conductance state with increase in number of cycles of excitation source. This property of memristor mimics strengthening of synapses. The effect of modifying control parameter in the Jogelkar window on the weight of the synaptic strength is also investigated. Two state memristor based logic generator circuit model is proposed, where logic states are defined by the number of cycles of the excitation source.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Powered Electrification in Uttar Pradesh State
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Due to the increase in industrialization for the various development programs energy crisis is being faced by many developing countries like India. If this is increased, the energy supplied from thermal based power plants causes environment concern and high cost of generation. India is endowed with these resources, which are both viable and economically exploitable. The small scale power generation near the consumer premises is receiving much attention in the recent years for its use in remote and rural communities because of the cost and complexity which is involved in the grid extension. India is currently the third largest producer of electricity in the world. India is the first country to set up a ministry for the non-conventional energy resources. Many of the Indian states show progressive development in RES’ programs, but few of the state yet lagging behind due to many issues that need to be avoided. Similar kind of challenges is observed in Uttar Pradesh state, inspite of the fact that the state has dedicated Renewable energy board and abundant RES potential. Consequently, this paper has been focused on the efforts to analyze the current status, challenges and various renewable energy policies implemented in Uttar Pradesh state of India to promote renewable energy.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Hybrid Micro-Grid in MATLAB for Fault Current Analysis in Different Modes of Micro-Grid Operations
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: A good protection system is a backbone of any grid. With the injection of distributed generators in the grid, the traditional protection system consisting of overcurrent relay is not sufficient to protect the system. It is therefore very important to understand the level of fault currents in the micro grids when they are connected to the grid and when they operate independently in the islanded mode. In this paper a micro grid consisting of different distributed generators such as wind turbine, solar panel, the fuel cell along with DC to DC converter and a 3-φ inverter feeding a 3-φ AC load is simulated in MATLAB. The simulated microgrid has been subjected to various faults in both grid connected and islanded mode and fault current levels are discussed in detail. The analysis done in this work is helpful in designing an effective and reliable protection scheme for the hybrid microgrid when operated in islanded and grid connected modes.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Tracking the Maximum Power from PV System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: A maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm changes with voltage and current (perturb & observe) technique for photovoltaic (PV) & 5-stage H-bridge multi stage inverter is connected with solar panel is presented in this research. This approach is suitable to implements highest power point tracking (PPT) & change DC power to AC power by changeable reference of voltage & current which are always changed during some time (up to 6 sec). In this technique a small disturbance is applied to the system. Due to the disturbances the output power of PV system changes. If power increases due to disturbances then the disturbances is continued in the previous direction. After the peak (highest) power is reached then power at next point decreases and thus after that the disturbances reverse. When the stable state is achieved, algorithm vibrates around the highest point. In order to remain the small power changes, disturbances (perturbation) size is kept very small in range. The technique is advanced in such a way that it fixed reference voltage of PV system equivalent to the highest voltage of the PV system.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation Control of Multi-Area Hydro Power System using Moth Flame Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: The novel moth-flame optimization (MFO) algorithm has been employed for the automatic generation control (AGC) mechanism of a three-area hydro power system model. This work is to suppress the damped oscillations, subjected to perturbation of load, for the studied model. The present aspect investigates the responses, which is dynamic in nature, in respect of area frequency and power of tie-line oscillations (the two main AGC indices). The constrained optimization problems that play key roles in the design of controller gains are formulated by implementing the propounded MFO algorithm. System AGC responses with the designed controller parameters are studied with two different natures of load profiles. The proposed MFO algorithm based fast acting Sugeno fuzzy logic (SFL) technique is applied for the investigated model of power system to obtain AGC responses for on-line, off-nominal operating condition. In both the off-line as well as the on-line normal operating conditions, robustness of the proposed MFO-SFL controllers is checked by varying some important physical parameters that deviate by ±25% from their rated values. The simulation based outcomes reveal that the propounded MFO based PID controller exhibit more dynamic control with robust performance as juxtaposed to the studied genetic algorithm based approach.

articleTitle: A comparative analysis of different load balancing algorithms on different parameters in cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: In recent days Cloud computing has made the trademark in hosting and delivering services to the personal or any organization. Everywhere and everybody is opting for cloud computing because it's beneficial uses i.e. worth to adopt the infrastructure, platform and services on the model of pay for only those services which are going to be used. Cloud computing gives the best infrastructure, new softwares and extended applications without investing for infrastructure maintenance, downloading, and installation of the softwares and without paying for the license cost for the individual computers and no requirement of personnel training for extended applications. Cloud computing provides the way to increase the services and capability of any organization at run time. Still cloud computing is at its initial state and many more researches are going on in this field and there are many obstacles that prevents the success of cloud computing. In this paper, a survey of cloud computing basic concepts, characteristics of cloud computing, deployment models, Environment for Load Balancing algorithms as well as research challenges are included. The aim of this paper is to find out the research direction in this vast technology. We discussed performance parameters which must be satisfied to design the efficient and effective algorithm. The algorithm which makes the better trade-off with these parameters will be considered good.

articleTitle: A Review of Various Techniques for Solar Radiation Estimation
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century is for the exploration of optimum utilization of Renewable Energy due to its great advantages over Non-renewable Energy. Among all other renewable energy like wind, tidal, etc. solar energy is preferred due to its abundancy and potential. Efficient utilization of Solar Energy is a great area of interest of the researchers. Optimum utilization of solar energy is directly related with amount of solar radiation received. Radiation data recorded by the measuring devices available at meteorological stations are the accurate one. But, due to its high cost and unavailability of meteorological stations everywhere, solar radiation is estimated based on geographical and meteorological parameters by the solar radiation estimation models. Modelling is executed mathematically or soft computing based techniques. Some of them are reviewed in this paper. They are compared and their results are analysed. Among Empirical Models, ANN Models, Fuzzy Models, ANN based Models are found to be most suitable one, due to better correlation and lesser statistical error rate like MBE or RMSE. Although, computational requirements are increased in ANN Models. Also, challenges behind solar radiation modelling and statistical evaluation methodologies are addressed.

articleTitle: Design of PID plus second order derivative controller for automatic voltage regulator using whale optimizatio algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This research work presents a metaheuristic technique, whale optimization technique (WOA) for optimizing the controller parameters of proportional-integral-derivative plus second order derivative (PIDD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) controller for controlling the automatic voltage regulator (AVR) system installed in the power generator system for stabilizing the terminal voltage. Distinct evolutionary optimization techniques are considered for the comparison task with the propounded controller on the basis of profiles of terminal voltage response of the investigated AVR system. The robustness of the propounded controller has been analyzed by altering the system parameters in which the response of the controller has been observed. It may be observed from the transient response outline of the terminal voltage and the robustness analysis that the proposed WOA based PIDD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> controller exhibits a highly improved robust control structure for controlling the AVR in electrical power system.

articleTitle: Review on e-Learning Environment Development and context aware recommendation systems using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Internet has open platforms for various domains to interact with each other. e-leaning is a domain which consistently getting attention because of “Learn any-time, anywhere” approach. Since, the start of e-learning environment development phase semantic web base ontology is used for describing and making relation between Learning Objects (LO's). Since contents are increasing every day, on this point ontologies are lagging to recommend. Development of recommendation using deep learning techniques are producing comparatively better results. Deep learning is now been used for classification, predictions, recommendations. It is also used in detection and segmentation techniques as well. This paper presents discussion various categories of recommendation systems. Then a comparative study is on deep learning-based recommendation systems. Major challenge that an e-learning environment is facing is because of “Cold-Start” and “Sparsity” in content based (CB) & collaborative Filter (CF) based recommendation systems. How to reduce Cold-Start and Sparsity is tried to find out in this paper.

articleTitle: Recent Strategies for Automatic Generation Control of Multi-Area Interconnected Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This paper contains a review on automatic generation control (AGC) of power system. A variety of resources and techniques are considered in this study. These reflect the literature of AGC schemes in the modern power system age as it covers adaptive, self-tuning control, digital control, optimization techniques, soft computing/artificial intelligence (AI) techniques, and other schemes. This article also provides summary of AGC systems with PV systems hydro and wind turbines. Additionally, it incorporates the effect from electric vehicle, micro-grid, and smart grid on the AGC schemes.

articleTitle: Precision Orbit Determination for Errored Dynamic Models
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Precision orbit determination (POD) these days emerging to be one of the paramount research domains in spaceflight tasks., predominantly in altimetric tasks such as earth observing system mission: Ice, Cloud, and land Elevation Satellite (ICESAT) mission, satellite oceanography mission: JASON-1., and ICESat., and ocean surface topography mission: TOPEX/POSEIDON, which demands high precision (in centimeters) for radial orbits. Although., there exists limitations on orbit determination accuracy which are mainly because of the pre-existing unmodeled accelerations. To counter this problem and thus, boosting orbit determination precision values for error driven dynamic models., new methodologies have been surfaced. Two predominantly used algorithms to handle such tasks are State Noise Compensation (SNC) and Dynamic Model Compensation (DMC). Research presented aims at investigating and comparing the two algorithms to demonstrate the efficacy of both. To demonstrate benefits associated, an extension is incorporated in which DMC of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order is defined based on the assumption that characterization of unmodeled acceleration is possible in terms of differential equation of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order, followed by an example. As a result, it is observed that DMC of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order tend to deliver more precise estimate of position, velocity, as well as acceleration., along with better stability in comparison to conventional SNC and DMC. Moreover, a numerical simulation is conducted using DMC of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order with substandard tracking information of Lower Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite and on comparison of results with those incorporating Kalman filter exclusively, it is assessed that for substandard tracking, DMC of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-order can perform efficiently delivering relatively precise trajectory estimation.

articleTitle: CNT based Textiles for Smart ECG Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Evolution of flexible, conformal and stretchable electronics incorporated with commercially available electronic modules embedded on a soft and elastic substrate is a critical technology in the domain of healthcare. Now-a-days, healthcare requirements have moved from a hospital-centric approach to a home-centric approach. This is because medical equipments have become portable so that the person's health parameters can be measured anywhere and at any point of time. These convenient oriented devices are brought to life because many diseases like heart related diseases which are unpredictable and require immediate attention of the medical expert. So, the concept of smart textiles can help reduce deaths due to heart diseases. Therefore, to achieve this technology, it becomes mandate to integrate smart materials i.e., nanomaterials like CNTs (Carbon Nanotubes), Graphene, Carbon Black, etc with the textiles. These materials are highly conductive, light-weight and possess high mechanical strength and can be incorporated in fabrics to accomplish the notion of `smart textiles'. Recent advancements in the synthesis of nanomaterial-based textiles have addressed several problems especially related to heart diseases. Basically, smart textiles help acquire ECG signals from the person and then the signals can be transmitted to the doctor for expert advice. Therefore, in this paper we throw light on the CNT based textiles for smart ECG monitoring.

articleTitle: FPGA Based Parallel Filters for Failure Recovery
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Parallel failure recovery and mean time between failures is very important for VLSI digital electronic circuits. Different fault tolerance mechanisms are available for designing a chip. But, they have some limitations, like: tolerance range, scatter/gather loading and data backup. The FFT(Fast Fourier Transforms)remain important components in several “communication” systems. The CMOS technology scaling is decreases day by day. So, parallel processing is necessary, because of these faults are occur. Parseval checks available for parallel fault protection but did not solve thesome technical problems. In order to remove above conflicts introduced the two models, i.e. 1 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> one is Automated Traditional Check-with Plancherel Function is proposed for parallel fault tolerance. In addition to this (2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> method) artificial intelligent algorithmic based fault tolerance (AIABFT) method is used for error correction codes. The combination of two schemes ATCPF, AIABFT gives the design complexity reduction and protection for combination and signal processing system.

Author Keywords: Artificial Intelligent Algorithmic Based Fault Tolerance (AIABFT)

articleTitle: Condition Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis Techniques of Electric Machines
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: From many decades electric motors are used in industries and to achieve better results in modern energy conversion industry the development and modernization of the electric motors is very necessary. Also, several types of motors are used in our day to day life for important services such as carriage, medical purpose, armed work, and to communicate. Therefore, it becomes very necessary to monitor the conditions of the motor continuously. However, due to the limited lifetime of a material, weakening of motor's components, contamination in parts, defects during manufacturing, or other damages during process, an electric motor can face serious problems. A sudden failure may lead to the loss of valuable human life or expensive machinery in the industry, which should be prohibited by precise spotting or continue monitoring of working condition of a motor. This paper presented a review on electrical and mechanical faults diagnosis methods used so far to improve the performance of motors and also helps to prevent the unnecessary replacement of motor's parts and suddenly shutdown the production unit.

articleTitle: Analyzing the resting-state EEG of action video game players using Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: Action video game is a video game genre that emphasizes on enhancing the mental ability of information processing. The present study considered the neural activation pattern of action video game players under the resting condition for assessment. EEG data are collected from 16-male action video-game players (AVGPs) and 19-male non-video-game players (NVGPs) using 19-electrodes during eyes open (EO) resting states. Spontaneous fluctuations in brain activity of participants are assessed by two consciousness index (CI) features, beta/theta and beta/alpha, computed using wavelet energies of theta, alpha, and beta frequency bands. Results show a higher level of resting state consciousness in AVGPs compared to NVGPs. When performances are evaluated using linear and nonlinear Support Vector Machines (SVMs), 93.97% classification accuracy is seen with beta/theta ratio whereas beta/alpha ratio produced 91.47% accuracy. The results of the analysis demonstrate that the effect of long-term gaming practice can be effectively analyzed by the wavelet transform based feature extraction technique described here.

articleTitle: Analysis of Various Topologies for Voltage Sag Compensation of Dynamic Voltage Restorer
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: During the voltage sag a power electronic device DVR (Dynamic voltage restorer) is considered to be the most efficient solution in electrical power distribution system. In order to mitigate the voltage sag and to restore load voltage to its rated value it is used to inject the three phase voltage in series and synchronism with the feeder at distribution side. A DVR comprises of series transformer, filter circuit, PWM inverter, controller system and a energy storage unit. This paper provides detailed study of the principle of operation, compensation strategies, control methods and the challenges faced by the DVR.

articleTitle: Power Quality Control of DFIG Using Smart Neural Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: This work has introduced the point by point model of the wind turbine system associated on MATLAB/SIMULINK at fluctuating speed. In the meantime, the task subject to control of turbine in over pitch viewpoint, voltage profile, power guideline and converter structures. Diverse cases are contemplated and results got are when contrasted with power computerized interface having control machine. The impacts procured recommend that the varieties in voltages at restrictive areas in vitality framework rendition are much less with DFIG the utilization of ANN controller contrasted with ordinary DFIG structures. They come back to reliable state esteems in the wake of encountering motions for parcels considerably less time. The oversee device is ground-breaking in controlling generator speed and receptive power at insignificant MVAR values. Additionally, the THD at various transports of power diminishes. As a whole, it could be reasoned that the proposed vitality change gadget can adorn the quality best of framework sooner or later of a short blame and hold the yield receptive power at 0 MVAR, rotor speed, pitch demeanor to 0 degree and furthermore lessens THD at different areas in power framework. In previous years' classical approach follows PID controllers and in this work objective is to replace such controllers by modern neural learning scheme. The methodology measures the system response and using neural based control model molds the system gain to bring the output at desired value with higher accuracy and within small time compared to methods used in past. Results are verified by voltage current and power curves.

articleTitle: Optimal Siting and Sizing of an Off-grid Integrated Renewable Energy System (IRES) For Remote Rural Electrification
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Recent Developments in Control, Automation & Power Engineering (RDCAPE)
abstract: In recent times, the decentralized electrical power generation via exhausting available renewable energy sources has emerged as a promising solution to the problem of power supply to remotely located and isolated rural population. In this paper, an Integrated Renewable Energy System (IRES) has been proposed for meeting the need of domestic, commercial, agricultural and community sector of the selected area considering per unit Energy Cost (EC), Actual Cost of Total Generation (ACTG), Total Energy Cost (TEC).Genetic Algorithm (GA) approach has been employed to minimize EC. Based on the obtained results an optimal solution is recommended for the rural electrification of the selected area.
